verification_notes: Pingdom's 'Compress components with gzip' grade (D67-F45 across pages) is a FALSE POSITIVE — verified via curl that www.we360.ai and media.we360.ai both serve Brotli compression (Content-Encoding: br) with gzip fallback for older clients. Pingdom's checker appears not to recognize Brotli. Not turned into a task.

Pingdom's 'Add Expires headers' grade (F23-E56 across pages) IS real — curl-verified Cache-Control: max-age=28800 (8 hours) on media.we360.ai assets. This is the exact scope of the sheet's already-'Done' ticket 'Raise static-asset cache TTL to 1 year' — confirms that fix has not reached production. Folded into the existing cache-lifetime task.

Every page shows exactly 3 'Error' content-type requests (15-17KB combined) in the response breakdown — consistent across 5 of 6 pages. Could not conclusively identify the exact failing URLs within this session's budget (Pingdom's own file-list detail would need to be paged through; a fresh browser load of the homepage didn't surface any 4xx/5xx in the first 18 requests, but lazy-loaded images below the fold weren't triggered). Logged as a task to investigate, flagged as needing more digging rather than a fully diagnosed root cause.
